title: Reversal Spend Allowance by Twelve-Month Net Qualifying Spend (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a points reversal after a grooming pass is cancelled and refunded, a reversal spend allowance is kept back from the reversal according to the membership's net qualifying spend over the last 12 months — its points-earning qualifying spend dated in the last 12 months less its points-reversal qualifying spend dated in the same period.

| Net qualifying spend over the last 12 months | Points kept back |
|---|---|
| $1500.00 or more | 30 |
| $800.00 or more, below $1500.00 | 15 |
| below $800.00 | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical).** $799.99: none. $800.00: 15. $1499.99: 15. $1500.00: 30.
